explanation: The Edict is what Ferdinand did with the Danish war won, and the article says so in its first four words: "Made overconfident by success, in March 1629, Ferdinand passed an Edict of Restitution." Wolgast is the last of the defeats that success is made of. "Von Arnim abandoned the siege on 4 August, but three weeks later Christian suffered another defeat at Wolgast. He began negotiations with Wallenstein". The negotiations became the Treaty of Lübeck in June 1629, three months before the Edict. The type is `precondition-of`, because the article makes Ferdinand's confidence the cause and not the battle.
